releaseNotes: Integrated Cloudflare Worker security authentication header (X-Launcher-Auth)
Standardized custom User-Agent header ('GamerZoneLauncher/1.3.2') across all HTTP requests
Enhanced error handling for HTTP 403 Forbidden with actionable user notifications
Auto-minimize main launcher window to Windows System Tray upon successful game launch
Added interactive system tray icon with double-click/right-click restore menu and single-click activation
Automated launcher window restoration to desktop upon ETS2 process exit
Updated window title bar minimize button icon to the Lucide minus path geometry
Optimized file verification and HEAD request checks against protected remote endpoints
